instances.spoken_text: A service business charges thirty dollars per unit, incurs unit variable cost of twenty dollars, and has annual fixed costs of two hundred and thirty thousand dollars. What minimum whole-number annual sales volume avoids a loss, in units?

follow_up.question: When might the assumed fixed cost stop being fixed?
follow_up.reference: The required volume may trigger another production line, location or management layer. Break-even should then be recalculated using the relevant capacity band and its additional committed cost.
